experiment_title: PREDICTA-26 Quantitative External Transferability & Domain Reality Check
disclaimer: External benchmark evaluation is an isolated domain-transfer experiment. It demonstrates domain boundaries and architectural transferability without modifying frozen production model weights or production qualification thresholds.

benchmark_evaluations.source_institution: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence

layer_1_static_limits.notes: Spec-sheet 3-sigma limits apply directly to RDSon and gate leakage.

layer_2_pat_mad.notes: Lot-level MAD screening reliably flags package wirebond lift and thermal runaways.

layer_3_copod.notes: Empirical copula tail probabilities detect multivariate degradation outliers without parametric assumptions.

layer_4_isolation_forest.notes: Unsupervised spatial partitioning detects anomalous thermal resistance spikes.

layer_5_xgboost_supervised.notes: Tree model trained on 28nm digital CMOS feature vectors cannot evaluate discrete power MOSFETs without retraining.

layer_6_gpr_prognostics.notes: RBF kernel degradation tracking successfully models RDSon and thermal resistance drift.

layer_7_physics_engine.notes: Arrhenius thermal acceleration and BTI / oxide degradation physics equations apply directly.

layer_8_governed_decision_pathway.notes: 4-way dispositioning safely routes uncertain thermal spikes to HOLD.

benchmark_evaluations.scientific_conclusion: Physics and unsupervised anomaly layers exhibit high zero-shot transferability to discrete power devices, whereas supervised XGBoost classifiers require domain-specific fine-tuning.

benchmark_evaluations.domain_name: Front-End Wafer Fabrication Inline Sensor Measurements
benchmark_evaluations.source_institution: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Semiconductor Fab
benchmark_evaluations.device_technology: Silicon Wafer Inline Fabrication Process (590 unnamed sensor channels)

layer_1_static_limits.notes: Unnamed sensor channels lack engineering units and physical limit bounds.

layer_2_pat_mad.notes: MAD algorithm applies mathematically across 590 channels if lot groupings are known.

layer_3_copod.notes: 590-dimensional copula estimation suffers from numerical instability without PCA.

layer_4_isolation_forest.notes: Isolation Forest can partition high-dimensional sensor spaces but requires retraining.

layer_5_xgboost_supervised.notes: Zero overlap with PREDICTA 28-feature CMOS burn-in contract.

layer_6_gpr_prognostics.notes: SECOM is static inline fab data, not temporal burn-in degradation trajectories.

layer_7_physics_engine.notes: Fab inline measurements (gas flow, RF power, chamber pressure) do not map to BTI/Tpd/Ileak CMOS equations.

layer_8_governed_decision_pathway.notes: Post-silicon burn-in disposition framework is semantically inappropriate for inline wafer scrap.

benchmark_evaluations.scientific_conclusion: PREDICTA honestly declares DOES_NOT_TRANSFER for front-end fab inline sensors. Attempting zero-shot inference across 590 unnamed sensor channels would violate PREDICTA's strict anti-fabrication principles.

benchmark_evaluations.domain_name: Automated Spatial Wafer Defect & Die Topology Clustering
benchmark_evaluations.device_technology: Silicon Wafers (Die X, Y coordinates, wafer maps, defect patterns)

layer_1_static_limits.notes: Wafer map defects are spatial patterns, not electrical spec breaches.

layer_2_pat_mad.notes: Spatial PAT / Good-Die-Bad-Neighborhood (GDBN) algorithms detect edge/ring clusters identically.

layer_3_copod.notes: Tail probability bounds detect anomalous spatial density concentrations.

layer_4_isolation_forest.notes: Isolation Forest cleanly isolates scratch and radial cluster anomalies.

layer_5_xgboost_supervised.notes: Electrical fault model does not classify optical/spatial defect geometries without retraining.

layer_7_physics_engine.notes: No transistor-level voltage/temperature telemetry available in ST-AWFD.

layer_8_governed_decision_pathway.notes: Genealogy/Topology Discrimination Engine successfully discriminates chamber vs spatial wafer clustering.

benchmark_evaluations.scientific_conclusion: PREDICTA's Spatial PAT and Genealogy Discrimination modules transfer directly to ST-AWFD wafer map analysis. Electrical drift and physics models are honestly designated NOT_APPLICABLE due to lack of time-series electrical telemetry.
